entries.name: ComedySportz Philadelphia (CSz Philly)
entries.summary: Philadelphia's longest-running comedy show, resident at The Adrienne Theater for over 25 years with live shows Friday through Sunday and classes for all levels.
entries.schedule: Live shows every Friday through Sunday
signals: Operating more than a quarter century
Resident at The Adrienne Theater on 'Philly's Funniest Block'
Six-plus distinct house shows beyond the flagship ComedySportz format
entries.reasons: A quarter-century-plus anchor tenant with the busiest show calendar of the Philadelphia theatres checked and an active class programme.

entries.name: Philly Improv Theater (PHIT)
entries.summary: Philadelphia's largest improv institution, running a multi-level class ladder from a beginner clinic through advanced Ensembles, plus a seasonal festival and open community-night jams.
entries.schedule: Fall PHEST Nov 20-21, 2026; student showcases Nov 29, 2026; Community Nights (open jam) ongoing
signals: Curriculum runs Essentials through Improv 401 plus specialty classes
Selective PHIT Ensembles for advanced graduates
Multiple Best of Philly awards, including a 2023 Distinguished Teaching honor
entries.reasons: Two decades of continuous operation, the deepest class ladder of the Philadelphia theatres checked, and a dedicated venue anchor this scene.

entries.name: Good Good Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: An independent black-box comedy venue running up to four shows a night across improv, sketch, and stand-up, plus classes in improv, sketch writing, and producing.
entries.schedule: Multiple shows nightly; class schedule by term, confirmed via email/phone rather than a public calendar
signals: Founded 2016 via a two-day Kickstarter campaign
2017 Philly.com Readers' Choice 'Best Live Theater Venue'
entries.reasons: A decade-old independent venue with real volume and local press recognition, though its class programme and public schedule are thinner than the established theatres.

entries.name: The N Crowd
entries.area: South Philadelphia, relocating to Mt. Airy in November 2026
entries.summary: A short-form improv troupe performing continuously since 2005, currently touring between rented venues rather than holding a permanent home.

signals: No permanent venue; mid-move as of October 2026
entries.reasons: Two decades of steady weekly shows, but no permanent venue and no class programme keep this well below the venue-anchored theatres.
